sources.title: Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1 begins service on August 1
sources.publisher: Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1 LLC / Flower Communications via PR TIMES
sources.attribution: Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1 LLC / Flower Communications via PR TIMES
sources.summary: Owner announcement confirms fit-out completion and services to data halls started August 1; IOWN connection to Tokyo also completed. Facility has six halls. Operational does not mean all tenant equipment is installed or fully occupied.
sources.date_semantics: Published August 5; explicit achieved service commencement August 1 is the status observation date. March 27 is earlier building completion, not the operational date.

sources.title: Tokyu announces completion of Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1; exact site parcel
sources.summary: PDF page 4 gives Ishikari Shinko Chuo 1-chome 722-1 parcel address, six halls and March 27 completion. This address supplies the identity bridge to the cadastral parcel.
sources.date_semantics: April 22 announcement describes March 27 completion; used for location identity and context, not recent operational status. Page 4 visually reviewed.

sources.title: GMO, Tokyu and BroadBand Tower plan GPU deployment inside operating Ishikari DC
sources.publisher: BroadBand Tower / Tokyu Land / GMO Internet
sources.attribution: BroadBand Tower / Tokyu Land / GMO Internet
sources.summary: Confirms host facility began service August 1. GMO plans to use part of BroadBand Tower Ishikari Shinko floor with operation targeted within 2026; future tenant deployment is not a second physical site or achieved GPU commissioning.
sources.date_semantics: October 7 publication explicitly repeats August 1 host opening. Planned 2026 GMO service remains a target.

sources.title: Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1 property specification
sources.summary: Undated facility page gives site area 14,215 square metres, six halls and indicative electrical specifications. It still displays a March 2026 completion forecast; later dated releases establish achieved milestones.
sources.date_semantics: Undated marketing page, retrieved October 13. Do not use retrieval date as status date.

sources.title: Miyagi AI Data Center completed July 24; housing services planned July 31
sources.summary: Joint development with Tohoku Electric on unused company land in Shichigahama. Explicit completion today; July 31 service commencement was still prospective on this publication date. Exact address is absent.
sources.date_semantics: July 24 is explicit completion date. July 31 service plan is not alone proof of achieved operations.

sources.title: BBIX and Getworks opened Miyagi AI DC OCX node September 1
sources.summary: September 30 release confirms OCX node opened September 1 at named Miyagi AI Data Center. This supports an operating network service at the facility, without proving every GPU container commissioned. Location remains municipality-only.
sources.date_semantics: Publication September 30; explicit achieved network-node opening September 1. No publication-to-observation substitution.

sources.title: Miyagi AI Data Center housing service and facility specifications
sources.summary: Primary four-page deck confirms July 24 completion but lists location only as Shichigahama, Miyagi. Receiving capacity is 50 kW per container and augmentable; it does not establish whole-site IT capacity.
sources.date_semantics: Deck dated July 24 and gives same-day facility completion. Future cooling and network upgrades remain planned.

sources.title: Mitsui Fudosan, Kumagai Gumi and Getworks announce Kobe underground DC
sources.summary: Named Kobe project uses about 3 km of former conveyor tunnel leased following September 4 award. Initial service planned end-2027 and eventual receiving capacity up to 20 MW. Development announcement does not establish physical installation.
sources.date_semantics: October 6 announcement; September 4 lease-award decision. No achieved physical construction or commissioning date selected.

sources.title: MOJ / AIGID 2026 Ishikari cadastral geometry: Shinko Chuo 1-chome 722-1
sources.publisher: AIGID; source registry map data by Japan Ministry of Justice
sources.attribution: Japan Ministry of Justice registry map data; AIGID GeoJSON conversion. Catalog license CC BY: http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/
sources.summary: Unique exact-address parcel matches Tokyu published site. Selected feature H000000005, map01235_2022_1; interior centroid141.298122,43.178556 locates campus only.
sources.date_semantics: 2026 dataset release, catalog resource created August10. Individual parcel survey/validity day unknown; publication date left null. Geometry is not a status observation.
